name: provider-agnostic-service-onboarding
purpose: Register governed AI and API services without coupling authorization to provider choice or performance ceilings.
principles: Authorization constrains who may invoke a service, not how capable the service may be.
Service tokens express identity, audience and scopes; they do not encode model, provider, throughput, context or compute ceilings.
Operational limits are opt-in per service and may be implemented outside the authorization layer.
Provider, model and endpoint selection remain runtime-configurable.
